historical_references.reference: Sultan Saml ibn Arslan defeated the Seljuqs in the Battle of Malazgird in 1071 CE, marking the end of Seljuq dominance in Anatolia and the beginning of the Seljuk-Danishmend Wars.

Sultan Saml Qutbuddin I (1316-1317 CE) reigned briefly over the Delhi Sultanate in India, during which time he was able to secure a peace treaty with the Mongol invaders under Özbeg Khan and maintain control of the sultanate's territories.
